items.t: Olanzapine, oral · Initial dose: 5 mg at night, increase to 10 mg at night. · Maximum dose: 20 mg at night.
Olanzapine, oral dispersible tablet or IM, 2.5–5 mg. · This can be repeated in 30–60 minutes, if required and then 6 hourly, to a maximum dose of 20 mg within 24 hours.
Olanzapine, oral dispersible tablet or IM, 2.5 to 5 mg. · This can be repeated in 30 to 60 minutes, if required and then 6 hourly to a maximum dose of 20 mg within 24 hours.
Olanzapine orodispersible tablet, oral or IM injection · Initiate 5 mg at night (2.5 mg in frail and elderly patients). · Titrate in increments of 2.5 mg to a maximum dose of 10 mg daily.
Olanzapine, oral dispersible tablet or IM, 2.5 to 5 mg. · Use lowest dose with caution in the elderly. · May be repeated in 30 to 60 minutes, if required.
lanzapine: Olanzapine 5–10 mg oro-dispersible tablet or IM • Repeat after 30–60 minutes if needed
Olanzapine, oral, for children 13 years and older. · Initially: 2.5–5 mg once daily. · Increase to 10 mg daily if necessary.

cautions.t: Do not give IM olanzapine within 1 hour of parenteral benzodiazepine (cardiorespiratory depression)

adverse_effects.t: Sedation, weight gain, hyperglycaemia, dyslipidaemia, postural hypotension
